Sandra ordered 200 pink calla lilies, which were five times the number of white carnations. So, the number of white carnations is \(200 \div 5 = 40\). She ordered four times as many red roses as white carnations, so the number of red roses is \(4 \times 40 = 160\). Since the red roses were missing from the delivery, Fred must deliver all 160 red roses.

Answer: 160
